sources.source: Personal crime prevalence CSEW open data table
sources.verified_fact: The current edition was released 23 April 2026 and reports CSEW estimates by offence group, age, sex and important demographic characteristics.
sources.quality_effect: Adds victimisation-prevalence context while forbidding national survey estimates from being converted into LSOA or parcel incident counts.

sources.source: Household crime prevalence CSEW open data table
sources.verified_fact: The current edition was released 23 April 2026 and provides CSEW prevalence estimates by offence group and household characteristics.
sources.quality_effect: Adds household-victimisation context; prevalence estimates remain survey-level evidence and are not parcel probabilities.

sources.source: Household crime incidence CSEW open data table
sources.verified_fact: The current edition was released 23 April 2026; ONS states that its incident-calculation methodology changed in December 2018 and earlier incidence or rate tables are not comparable with current outputs.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an explicit time-series comparability guard so pre-change and post-change incidence estimates are not silently merged.

sources.source: Perceptions criminal justice system CSEW open data table
sources.verified_fact: The current edition was released 23 April 2026 and provides CSEW estimates across demographic and household characteristics.
sources.quality_effect: Adds public-confidence context while preventing perceptions from being interpreted as recorded crime, response performance or parcel safety.

sources.verified_fact: The official dataset was updated 8 July 2026 and provides rolling 12-month police-recorded-crime totals by Community Safety Partnership, quarter and individual offence code.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a recent local-authority-level cross-check with the official user-guide interpretation requirement; it remains area-level and not parcel evidence.

quality_guards: AREA_LEVEL_PROXY only; no parcel measurement claim.
CSEW prevalence and incidence estimates are survey-level evidence, not local event counts.
Household crime incidence tables cross a December 2018 methodology change.
Criminal-justice perceptions are not crime prevalence or service-performance measures.
Community Safety Partnership totals are area-level cross-checks and require the official user guide.
No existing candidate score or stored parcel value was modified.
